label: mycorrhizal symbiosis
definition: A symbiotic process in which one participant is a member of Glomeromycota, forming associations with plant root tissue.

label: nitrogen-fixing symbiosis
definition: A symbiotic process in which one participant is a member of Hyphomicrobiales (rhizobia) that converts atmospheric nitrogen to a form usable by the host.

label: coral-zooxanthellae symbiosis
definition: A symbiotic process in which one participant is a member of Symbiodiniaceae, forming intracellular associations with coral hosts.
